what: When user says "add this as Phase X feature" or "add to remaining work" or "add to spec" — update the DOCUMENT first (docs/specs/PHASE_0_1_SPEC.md or relevant file), THEN optionally store a memory pointing to it. Don't store a memory as a substitute for updating the doc. aide_remember is for cross-session agent context. Docs/specs are the primary artifact for project decisions and plans.
why: User had to explicitly ask "Can both be in PHASE_0_1_SPEC?" after I stored Phase 2 pro features only as memories. The stop hook nudges toward aide_remember, but that shouldn't be the default action for project decisions — docs come first.
